items.distractor_fact: នៅផ្ទះមួយជិតច្បារ អ្នកជិតខាងម្នាក់បានកត់ត្រាសីតុណ្ហភាពក្នុងផ្ទះខ្លួនបានកម្រិត {D} អង្សាសេ ក្នុងព្រឹកដដែល។
items.gloss_en: At a house near the garden, a neighbor recorded the temperature inside their own home as {D}°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different person (a neighbor recording their own home's temperature), not an instrument at a different place as the first distractor was.

items.distractor_fact: វិនិយោគិនម្នាក់ទៀតបានទិញភាគហ៊ុនរបស់ក្រុមហ៊ុនមួយផ្សេងទៀតក្នុងតម្លៃ {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងថ្ងៃដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A different investor bought shares of another company for {D} dollars that same day.
items.entity_note: a different person (an individual investor), not another company, as the owner of the third quantity.

items.distractor_fact: កសិករម្នាក់ដែលរស់នៅជិតទំនប់មួយផ្សេង បានវាស់ឃើញកម្រិតទឹកក្នុងស្តុកទឹករបស់ខ្លួនផ្ទាល់បាន {D} ម៉ែត្រ ក្នុងថ្ងៃដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A farmer living near a different dam measured the water level in his own private storage pond as {D} meters that same day.
items.entity_note: a different person (a farmer's own private pond), not another reservoir as a place.

items.distractor_fact: អ្នកឡើងភ្នំម្នាក់ពាក់នាឡិកាវាស់កម្ពស់ផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន ហើយបានឃើញលេខបង្ហាញកម្ពស់ {D} ម៉ែត្រពីដី ក្នុងពេលដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A hiker wearing his own personal altimeter watch saw a reading of {D} meters above the ground at the same time.
items.entity_note: a different person (a hiker with a personal altimeter), not another drone as an object.

items.distractor_fact: អ្នកដឹកជញ្ជូនម្នាក់កំពុងកាន់កញ្ចប់មួយផ្សេងទៀតដោយផ្ទាល់ដៃ ហើយបានថ្លឹងឃើញទម្ងន់ {D} គីឡូក្រាម ក្នុងពេលដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A courier personally carrying a different package weighed it at {D} kilograms at the same time.
items.entity_note: a different person (a courier), not another package sitting in the warehouse.

items.distractor_fact: ក្រុមហ៊ុនមួយនៅតំបន់ជិតខាងមានចំនួនកម្មករចំនួន {D} នាក់ ក្នុងឆ្នាំដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A company in a nearby area had a workforce of {D} people that same year.
items.entity_note: a different kind of owner (a company/organisation), not another village as a place.

items.distractor_fact: អ្នកជិះកង់ម្នាក់បានជិះកង់ដោយល្បឿន {D} គីឡូម៉ែត្រក្នុងមួយម៉ោង នៅផ្លូវកោងតែមួយ។
items.gloss_en: A cyclist was riding at {D} km/h on the same curve.
items.entity_note: a different person (a cyclist), not another car as a vehicle.

items.distractor_fact: គណនីធនាគាររបស់អាជីវកម្មតូចមួយបានទទួលការដាក់ប្រាក់សរុបចំនួន {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងខែដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A small business's bank account received total deposits of {D} dollars that same month.
items.entity_note: a different kind of owner (a business/organisation), not another individual person's account.

items.distractor_fact: អ្នកលក់ដូរតាមផ្លូវម្នាក់មានចំណូលសរុបចំនួន {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងខែដដែល។
items.gloss_en: A street vendor had total income of {D} dollars that same month.
items.entity_note: a different person (an individual street vendor), not another shop as an organisation.

items.distractor_fact: មូលនិធិវិនិយោគមួយបានទទួលប្រាក់ចំណេញសរុបចំនួន {D} ដុល្លារ ក្នុងឆ្នាំដដែល។
items.gloss_en: An investment fund earned total gains of {D} dollars that same year.
items.entity_note: a different kind of owner (an institutional investment fund), not another individual investor's portfolio.

items.distractor_fact: អ្នកបញ្ជូនកញ្ចប់ម្នាក់បានបញ្ជូនកញ្ចប់មួយឲ្យទៅដល់ទីតាំងជាក់ស្តែងនៅពេលស្មើនឹង {D} គិតជានាទី ដោយផ្អែកលើកាលវិភាគផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់គាត់។
items.gloss_en: A courier delivered a package, actually arriving at a time equal to {D} minutes, going by his own separate delivery schedule.
items.entity_note: a different person (a courier with his own schedule), not another train on a different line.

items.distractor_fact: ក្រុមហ៊ុនមួយផ្សេងទៀតមានការិយាល័យសាខានៅជាន់ដែលមានលេខរៀងស្មើនឹង {D} រាប់ពីជាន់សំរេចផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនរបស់ខ្លួន។
items.gloss_en: A different company has a branch office on a floor whose number equals {D}, counting from that company's own reference floor.
items.entity_note: a different kind of owner (a company's own numbering system), not another building as a place.
